facts.title: Overnight Oats
ingredients: ⅓ cup homemade muesli, or ⅓ cup old-fashioned oats plus ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 tablespoon almond butter or peanut butter
½ cup milk of choice for a very thick consistency, or up to ⅔ cup milk for a lighter consistency
Drizzle of maple syrup or honey, if desired
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
